examples.text: The detective realized that the woman waiting on the corner was a <w>professional</w>.

examples.text: He mistakenly thought she was a <w>professional</w> because of where she was standing.

target_lang_translations.de: Aufgrund ihres Standorts hielt er sie fälschlicherweise für eine <w>Professionelle</w>.
